notes.title: New update! Oculus Link and Virtual Desktop support
notes.content:
Hello SWATs!

Now Crisis VRigade works flawlessly on Oculus Quest and Oculus Quest 2 with Virtual Desktop and Oculus Link. 

One of the latest Oculus update messed up a few things, so thank you for your feedback to help us to be aware of the issue. We have fixed the Oculus Link problem and we have fixed also the bug with sounds for Virtual Desktop.

Enjoy Crisis VRigade at full resolution and smoothness!

notes.title: Version 1.12 released. Coop multiplayer ready!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

After a long development and some delays we have released the coop multiplayer mode. It has been very, very, very tested and it works flawlessly.

If you can't finish the game alone, ask for help to your friends. The coop mode, makes the game easier, but as Mr. Wolf said: "let's not start sucking each others d**** quite yet", because it is still a challenge... Or play it just for fun, because it is a blast.

Features:

- Cooperative online mode up to 3 players
- Random and private rooms
- Friendly fire is allowed, be careful with your partners!
- Missions can be unlocked too, ask for help to your friends!
- Play locked missions if your friend has it unlocked

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.8 Ready! Retry button
notes.content:
This new version has some improvements:

- A retry button when you are dead. You will not have to back to the police station to retry the mission.
- Performance boost. Always is possible more performance, hehe.
- WMR and HTC reset orientation improvement.
- Improved 2 hands weapons. Now you will feel better aiming with them.
- Small bug fixes.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.5 Ready! New Mission: Port Ambush
notes.content:
A new mission is awaiting for you: A smuggler group are trying to take money from the black market through the port. Don’t let them do it and don’t let their boss escape. The air units confirm the presence of an helicopter. Stop it!

This new release has a lot of improvements:

- Improved sound effects
- Audio help (hear it, you will get some hints)
- Improved AI movements
- Improved AI aim
- Added a shooting range
- Lots of surprises
- Lots of action
- Big Game Over
- A surprise in the bank last scene
- Difficulty has been reviewed and relaxed a bit. But still, don't expect to Rambo the game and finish it with easy.
- Added more standing positions on the port.
- A LOT of small things

Thanks to the community for all the feedback. Crisis VRigade will become awesome with your help.

Enjoy!

PS: Beware of the RPG.

notes.title: Version 1.4 Released!
notes.content:
This new version is awesome! There are some cool features:

- Now the game will show the bullet trace when you get hit. Use your 3 seconds of invulnerability to retailate!
- Enemy aim algorithm improved. Be careful, you will be shot if you are exposed.
- There is a settings menu to adjust the height. 
- Select manual or auto reload on the settings menu.

Some bugs have been fixed. Thank you very much to all people that helped to find them.

Stay tuned! The new scenario will be ready very soon.

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.3 'Put you Hands in the Air' update
notes.content:
Prepare yourself for this new update.

You’re put in the middle of the action, bullets flying around, and now you have to reload, with your bare hands! 

Take our advice and gain weapon stability using both hands to aim.

Thanks to the community for all the feedback we're getting, helping us making Crisis VRigade better every day.

notes.title: Version 1.2 released!
notes.content:
We have worked very hard on this version that comes with a ton of improvements and some new cool features.

New features:

 New bonuses: Lifes and bullet time
 "Ready, set, go!" (visual and sound) on the beginning of a level. It will be crystal clear for player when they have to cover
 Get rid of "Out of play area".
 New score system


Improvements:

 FPS boosted
 Difficulty relaxed a bit (a bit!!) on rookie and hell (but you still can't Rambo it).


Bug fixes:

 Colliders fixed
 Gun stops firing in police station
 Some other bugs fixed
